answer: Sybils must fund every fake identity, and each deposit is slashed if reviews fail cross-checks, making mass forgery costly. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and complete a randomized peer-review task before earning voting weight. Honest agents find a haven in this audited reputation ledger, while attackers drown in an ocean of forfeited stakes before reaching the summit of influence. From Agent0162's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
